remove-dead-outputs.description: Remove usages of outputs removed in this version that had already stopped firing: Overlay's onAnimationStart/onAnimationDone (and OverlayOptions config callbacks), and MenubarSub's menuFocus/menuBlur/menuKeydown.

styleclass-to-class.description: Rewrite styleClass/[styleClass] to class/[class] on selectors whose styleClass input was removed in this version in favor of the native class attribute: p-toast, p-message, p-tag, p-skeleton, p-card, p-radiobutton/p-radioButton/p-radio-button, p-progressbar/p-progressBar/p-progress-bar, p-divider, p-progressspinner/p-progressSpinner/p-progress-spinner, p-timeline, p-toolbar, p-avatar, p-chip, p-inputgroup/p-inputGroup/p-input-group, p-iconfield/p-iconField/p-icon-field, p-inputicon/p-inputIcon/p-input-icon, p-toggleswitch/p-toggleSwitch/p-toggle-switch, p-colorpicker/p-colorPicker/p-color-picker, p-metergroup/p-meterGroup/p-meter-group, p-inplace, p-togglebutton/p-toggleButton/p-toggle-button, p-terminal, p-blockui/p-blockUI/p-block-ui, p-badge, p-checkbox/p-checkBox/p-check-box, p-panel, p-dock, p-accordion, p-knob, p-splitter, p-scrollpanel/p-scrollPanel/p-scroll-panel, p-image, p-editor, p-slider, p-paginator, p-organizationchart/p-organizationChart/p-organization-chart, p-carousel, p-dataview/p-dataView/p-data-view, p-splitbutton/p-splitButton/p-split-button, p-password, p-inputnumber/p-inputNumber/p-input-number, p-menubar, p-panelmenu/p-panelMenu/p-panel-menu, p-megamenu/p-megaMenu/p-mega-menu, p-cascadeselect/p-cascadeSelect/p-cascade-select, p-datepicker/p-datePicker/p-date-picker, p-tree, p-select, p-listbox/p-listBox/p-list-box, p-orderlist/p-orderList/p-order-list, p-table, p-autocomplete/p-autoComplete/p-auto-complete, p-multiselect/p-multiSelect/p-multi-select and p-treetable/p-treeTable/p-tree-table.

remove-dead-inputs.description: Remove usages of inputs removed in this version that had already stopped doing anything: showTransformOptions, hideTransformOptions, showTransitionOptions and hideTransitionOptions of p-toast; showTransformOptions, hideTransformOptions, showTransitionOptions and hideTransitionOptions of p-toastItem; showTransitionOptions and hideTransitionOptions of p-message; showTransitionOptions and hideTransitionOptions of p-overlay; showTransitionOptions and hideTransitionOptions of p-colorPicker/p-colorpicker/p-color-picker; size of p-overlayBadge/p-overlay-badge/p-overlaybadge; transitionOptions of p-fieldset; transitionOptions of p-panel; transitionOptions of p-accordion; showTransitionOptions and hideTransitionOptions of p-scrollTop/p-scrolltop/p-scroll-top; showTransitionOptions and hideTransitionOptions of p-confirmpopup; inputId of p-togglebutton/p-toggleButton/p-toggle-button; showTransitionOptions, hideTransitionOptions and ariaCloseLabel of p-popover; showTransitionOptions, hideTransitionOptions, modalEnterAnimation and modalLeaveAnimation of p-image; transitionOptions of p-drawer; showTransitionOptions and hideTransitionOptions of p-menu; showTransitionOptions, hideTransitionOptions and plain of p-splitbutton/p-splitButton/p-split-button; showTransitionOptions and hideTransitionOptions of p-password; badgeClass of p-button; autoZIndex, baseZIndex and popup of p-contextMenuSub/p-contextmenu-sub; showTransitionOptions and hideTransitionOptions of p-tieredMenu/p-tieredmenu/p-tiered-menu; autoZIndex and baseZIndex of p-menubar; autoZIndex, baseZIndex, mobileActive, ariaLabel and ariaLabelledBy of p-menubarSub/p-menubarsub; transitionOptions and tabindex of p-panelMenu/p-panelmenu/p-panel-menu; disabled and queryMatches of p-megaMenuSub/p-megamenu-sub; showTransitionOptions, hideTransitionOptions and containerClass of p-galleria; removeStyleClass of p-fileupload/p-fileUpload; inputLabel and emptyMessage of p-cascadeSelect/p-cascadeselect/p-cascade-select; showTransitionOptions and hideTransitionOptions of p-datePicker/p-datepicker/p-date-picker; transitionOptions and rtl of p-dialog; closeAriaLabel, acceptAriaLabel, rejectAriaLabel, rtl, transitionOptions, focusTrap and defaultFocus of p-confirmDialog/p-confirmdialog/p-confirm-dialog; rowNode, root, firstChild and lastChild of p-treeNode; visible and itemSize of p-selectItem; frozenColumns and frozenWidth of p-table; autoZIndex, baseZIndex, showTransitionOptions and hideTransitionOptions of p-autoComplete/p-autocomplete/p-auto-complete; filterFields of p-multiSelect/p-multiselect/p-multi-select; transitionOptions of p-stepper; autoHighlight of p-autoComplete/p-autocomplete/p-auto-complete; searchLocale of p-listbox/p-listBox/p-list-box; gridStyleClass and trackBy of p-dataView/p-dataview/p-data-view; trackBy and header of p-orderList/p-orderlist/p-order-list; trackBy, sourceTrackBy and targetTrackBy of p-pickList/p-picklist/p-pick-list; size of p-toggleswitch/p-toggleSwitch/p-toggle-switch; tabindex of p-selectButton/p-selectbutton/p-select-button; baseZIndex of p-confirmpopup; ariaLabelAsc and ariaLabelDesc of p-treeTableSortIcon/p-treetable-sort-icon/p-tree-table-sort-icon. The dead dir input of p-splitbutton/p-splitButton/p-split-button is removed too, but its dir/[dir] bindings are left in place: they keep working as the host element's native dir attribute. Programmatic reads/writes of the removed names are reported for manual review.

config-overlay-options-signal.description: Rewrite programmatic access to Exhaustive.overlayOptions, which is a signal in this version: assignments become .set(value) and reads become () calls.

renamed-outputs.description: Rename event bindings of outputs renamed in this version to the name the other components use: onFilterEvent to onFilter on p-orderList/p-orderlist/p-order-list; selectAllChange to onSelectAllChange on p-table; onPanelShow to onShow and onPanelHide to onHide on p-multiSelect/p-multiselect/p-multi-select. The event payloads are unchanged, so $event keeps working. A p-table [(selectAll)] two-way binding, which relied on selectAllChange, is reported for manual review, as are programmatic references to the old names.

config-input-style-to-variant.description: Rename the global inputStyle option, removed in this version, to inputVariant (same values): the inputStyle key of provideExhaustive()/setConfig() config objects, and reads and writes of Exhaustive.inputStyle. Config objects that set both names, receivers that cannot be proven to be the Exhaustive service and template reads are reported for manual review.

renamed-templates.description: Rename templates removed in this version to their replacement inside the elements that project them: the removetokenicon template (#removetokenicon or pTemplate="removetokenicon") becomes chipicon in p-multiSelect/p-multiselect/p-multi-select; both receive the same context. An element that already projects a chipicon template is reported for manual review.

renamed-inputs.description: Rename bindings of deprecated input aliases removed in this version to their replacement: showCloseIcon to closable on p-drawer; dropdownAppendTo to appendTo on p-paginator; maxLength to maxlength on p-password; minLength to minQueryLength on p-autoComplete/p-autocomplete/p-auto-complete; containerStyleClass to class and containerStyle to style on p-treeSelect/p-treeselect/p-tree-select; virtualRowHeight to virtualScrollItemSize on p-treeTable/p-treetable/p-tree-table; filterPlaceHolder to filterPlaceholder on p-listbox/p-listBox/p-list-box and p-multiSelect/p-multiselect/p-multi-select; ariaLabelledby to ariaLabelledBy on p-imageCompare/p-imagecompare/p-image-compare; ariaCloseLabel to closeAriaLabel on p-drawer; the deprecated pass-through aliases of attribute directives on any element carrying them: ptButtonDirective to pButtonPT on [pButton], ptButtonLabel to pButtonLabelPT on [pButtonLabel], ptButtonIcon to pButtonIconPT on [pButtonIcon], ptBadgeDirective to pBadgePT on [pBadge], ptInputText to pInputTextPT on [pInputText], ptTooltip to pTooltipPT on [pTooltip]; size to badgeSize on [pBadge] placed on a plain element (on a component or an input/select, size belongs to the element). A tag that already binds the replacement is reported for manual review, as are programmatic reads/writes of the removed names.
